note: site header -- renders the operator's fixed menu, logo, search controls, account controls, and other header interface; the echoed search query is excluded
main-menu control -- renders the operator's fixed menu control vocabulary
site logo -- renders the operator's fixed logo and tagline
search interface -- renders the operator's fixed search controls; the query entry is excluded because it can echo user input
user-account navigation -- renders fixed support, account-creation, and login controls
skip-navigation link -- renders the operator's fixed jump-to-content control
article navigation tabs -- renders the fixed Article and Talk controls
page-action navigation -- renders fixed view, edit, history, page-tools, and appearance-navigation controls
appearance settings -- renders fixed appearance labels, radio choices, and controls
help indicator -- renders the operator's fixed help control
history-search panel -- renders the fixed history-search control vocabulary
pager navigation -- renders fixed first, previous, next, last, and page-number controls
history comparison control -- renders the fixed compare-selected-versions button
history list heading -- renders the operator-defined fixed history-section label
history selection controls -- renders the fixed radio-button role for selecting revisions
revision comparison controls -- renders fixed current, previous, and comparison-navigation links
user-tool navigation -- renders fixed Talk and contributions controls
history action tools -- renders the operator's fixed revision-action controls
footer policy and site links -- renders fixed privacy, about, disclaimer, contact, legal, conduct, developer, statistics, cookie, and mobile-view links
footer branding links -- renders the operator's fixed project and platform-branding images
